## Resulting typed behavior

Drive admission uses requestDriveMachineRegeneration's single original UoW. Verified current actor/edit permission/active workspace, confirmed note version, selected available immutable backup record, recorder/linked subject/epoch, original HTML or Markdown <=52428800 bytes are checked before creating the binding and the same-ID machine/generic job. Both prior machine and existing LLM executor+command are checked; Drive intent hashes a fixed versioned array of recipe/note/version/record/machine, excluding generated job IDs and mutable progress. Same command/content returns its original receipt even after progress; changed content/cross-kind conflicts. Bind, job, batch, original processing and revision baseline are in the same Tx; wake only after original run returns.

Local request digest and branch behavior remain unchanged. The shared admission body preserves local head→jobID→batchID→generation→batch/job/machine/original write order; Drive supplies its server-generated consumer jobID needed for the cyclic deferred binding FK. No SourceBindingCodec/DDL changes.

currentDriveSource extracts the existing active-capture DB checks. currentMachine also invokes it with machine request fingerprint, so closed final Tx checks current actor/note revision/ownership/original/generic job plus binding consumer/executor/cancel/original/hash/bytes/generation, record/target/recorder, Drive epoch and subject. This helper needs no active input receipt. Active capture retains its original lease/receipt/native-memory checks; it is not reused after input.finish.

Drive worker order: original readInput acquire → original prepareMachine → current note/body preparation (before finish) → phase final-check → readInput final inspect → original saved closure/readback/ACK → original input.finish/finishInput → closed final Tx currentMachine → original adoptBody/terminal transaction → original deferred completion/ACK finally. Local order remains acquire/prepare→finish/finishInput→prepareBody→final Tx. Drive metadata uses original HTTP/provider identity and repeats checkCurrent after metadata response. Final remote inspect remains lease-active; no external remote check is invented after close.

ACK type evidence: DriveExecution.confirmSourceAcknowledged(proof) is Promise<void>; SourceExecution requires the same method as nonoptional Promise<void>. acknowledgeSourceClosure already saves/reads and calls this method once with the original proof. It is never called a second time or tested as boolean. A maintenance/ACK rejection marks the original input lease unknown and throws existing LlmOperationError(LLM_OWNERSHIP_UNKNOWN, not-sent, closed=false), so worker cannot finish/adopt body; original caller-ended, saved/readback receipt, proof consumption and deferred finally retain their existing semantics. Unknown closure does not become a public success/native proof.

Shared Node input/execution/ownership/progress/extractor/local resources are allocated once before OpenRouter. Drive factory reuses original NodeDriveHttp/source and original DriveExecution. Late typed machine composition after Drive pairs provider+Drive execution with exactly those same shared resource references; no second resource factory/native admission or OpenRouter requirement. Retry of closed Drive job requires explicit source reconfirmation instead of silently delegating to the local-original request.
